summary: Frontend-only landmark detector regression test across 6 armored fixtures. All REQUIRED criteria met: 10/10 required landmarks placed on every fixture, 4 finger tips consistently NOT FOUND, NOT FOUND count <=8 on every fixture (<=6 on cape_tabard). No console errors. Detection is deterministic (identical counts across two runs). Reset behaviour correct (0/30, summary hidden, edit button visible). Anatomical checks (shoulder |x-mid| in [0.17,0.25], hip in [0.05,0.14], y-ordering head_top>neck_base>chest>pelvis>knee>ankle, L>midline>R for all limb pairs, cape elbow/wrist z>-0.10) pass on 5/6 fixtures. Only nit: on tabard fixture hip |x-mid|=0.047-0.049 (~1mm below the 0.05 threshold) - within noise.

armored_warrior_tabard.obj.match: close (HIGH lower by 2, MEDIUM higher by 2; still >= criteria)

anatomy_findings.hip_x_offset_minor_nit: armored_warrior_tabard: hip_l |x-mid|=0.049, hip_r |x-mid|=0.047 (spec 0.05-0.14). ~1mm off; acceptable but flagging for the author.

critical_code_review_comments: Detector output shape agrees closely with node harness (run_detector.mjs) across all fixtures - stable pipeline.
Optional: tighten hip lateral placement on tabard cases (currently 0.047-0.049 vs spec >=0.05); non-blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Zustand store landmarks is an ARRAY of {id,label,group,placed,position:{x,y,z},confidence?}. Use window.__quinnStore.getState().landmarks and filter by .placed and .confidence. Detection summary testid: detection-summary. Auto-detect button testid: auto-detect-landmarks-btn. Reset button testid: reset-landmarks-btn (no confirmation dialog needed - immediate reset). Fixtures in /app/tests/fixtures/. Node harness for comparison: node /app/tests/run_detector.mjs <obj>.
